heading: Today
text: Areas of dense valley fog to start.  Mostly sunny, mixing with some high clouds north of Rt. 2 and west of the Green Mountains.  Sun fading through increasing clouds in NH, eastern, and southern VT.  Highs in the mid 60s to low 70s, warmest north.  Winds light, becoming north to northeast near 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds north of Rt. 2 and west of the Green Mountains.  Cloudy east and south. A chance of showers late near the MA border.  Lows in the 40s.  Winds north to northeast near 10 mph in the Champlain Valley and south, light in the rest of the north.

heading: Saturday
text: Some limited sun, lots of clouds from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north.  Mostly cloudy elsewhere, with a rising chance of showers south of the White Mountains and Rt. 4, becoming likely in the afternoon, possibly reaching Rt. 2 late.  Highs from 60 south to 70 north.  Winds north to northeast 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.
